summary: Directive 005 · Phase 1a NextGen Foundation — end-to-end test PASSED. 19/19 backend pytest cases green and full UI happy path (Overview→Properties→New Mission→Advance→Audit) verified. Legacy Landing and CEO portal login gate unaffected.

issues: React console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' triggering a hydration error notice. Source is likely a global shadcn Select wrapper that injects a span into the <option>. Cosmetic/dev-only warning, does not affect flow, but should be resolved before Phase 1b.

action_items: Optional: eliminate hydration warning on NewMission property <select> by replacing raw <option> children (currently plain text — warning appears to come from a global shadcn Select portal). No functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: nextgen/db.py imports `core.db` — coupling is acceptable Phase 1a but should evolve into a dedicated NextGen connection when Phase 1c introduces the immutable Passport ledger.
resolve_property returns decision=auto_match when 1 candidate matches, but does not score candidates — Phase 1b should incorporate a fuzzy score threshold as designed in SD-002.
advance_mission uses `body.to_stage`; caller currently sends stage+1. Consider server-side `next_stage_only` semantics (accept no body → auto-advance by 1) to prevent accidental multi-stage jumps.

audit_events writes are best-effort (no transaction with the parent mutation). Phase 1c should introduce outbox pattern or transactional write to keep audit trail truly immutable/complete under partial failure.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all Phase 1a UI acceptance criteria met, incl. legacy Landing + /ceo/login non-regression
